summary: A library team ready to teach asks community groups to find a room it can use without a fee.
realLife: The library president asked South End organizations to identify accessible space that the community learning team could occupy free of charge.
inGame: needs: staff availability and room requirements.

turns.pulledBy: A group offers an accessible room at no charge.
turns.what: The team checks dates with the host.
turns.writesBack: An off-site session can be listed once the host confirms.

turns.pulledBy: The offered room is free but inaccessible.
turns.what: Staff ask about a different room in the same building.
turns.writesBack: The first offer stays off the public schedule.
